description:
This mapping is responsible for loading fact records for the table W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F based on the corresponding staging area table. This mapping takes care of inserting new records as well as updating existing records in the target table. On a requirement basis, this mapping also 'soft-deletes' records from the target table (meaning, marking a record as 'Deleted' instead of physically deleting them).

Modified by : Malini Krishnan
Release : 3.1
Added fields PORL_ENCUMBERED_FLAG and PORL_LINE_LOCATION_ID to the table W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_F and the mapping logic for it to bridge the ETL Gap
